parole.significato: cupboard, closet, cabinet, or similar piece of furniture
parole.testo: From Proto-Semitic *ʾarān- or *ʾirān-. Cognate to Phoenician 𐤀𐤓𐤍 (ʾrn). Sense 4 is a semantic loan from English expressions like in the closet.

parole.significato: star (any small, natural and bright dot in the sky, most visible in the night or twilight sky)
parole.testo: From Proto-Semitic *kabkab-. Cognate with Ge'ez ኮከብ (kokäb). The senses relating to fame are a semantic loan from English star.

parole.significato: mouse (such a rodent that is of the genus Mus)
parole.testo: From Proto-Semitic *ʿakbar- (“mouse”), cognate with Arabic عَكْبَر (ʕakbar). The computing term is a semantic loan from English mouse.
